intro: I'm a SaaS Implementation Consultant with 3+ years of experience delivering enterprise ERP and Accounts Receivable automation solutions for Fortune 500 clients. I specialize in bridging business and technology to drive measurable operational impact.

At HighRadius, I led multiple end-to-end implementations, significantly reducing manual effort and improving processing efficiency. I've also turned around critical client implementations from red to green by optimizing workflows and aligning stakeholders.

Currently, at Purdue University, I'm advancing my expertise in data analytics while working on a banking practicum project focused on identifying workflow inefficiencies and delivering data-driven automation recommendations.
